name: Caves Road Yallingup
_note: Caves Road (Tourist Drive 250) from Dunsborough to Yallingup and on south past the Ngilgi Cave turn: west along the coast through peppermint and marri, climbing onto the Leeuwin-Naturaliste ridge to Yallingup. Point to point, about 11 km. The first South West track; Busselton to Dunsborough can be added later. Country road settings like Tuart Drive's: a 70 m corridor and coarser terrain to keep the length within budget; gentle banking on the bends.
